results.overview: Berlin — a city-state on the brink. While a privileged few live beneath a climate-controlled dome, those outside struggle to survive in a world ravaged by heat, corruption, and crime. After years apart, sisters Bea and Phoebe are reunited and uncover a dark secret: Vampires are determined to seize political power — and blood has become the city's new currency.
results.name: City of Blood

results.original_name: 滿清十三皇朝之血染紫禁城
results.name: Rise & Fall of Qing Dynasty - Bloodshed Over the Forbidden City
